title: config/taxonomy/editions.yaml (drydocs.editions.v1)
description: Shape only (S6): the edition registry, one row per declared edition -- the id segment (2-5 uppercase letters) keyed to an Area Product (gate ontology-domain-registry-and-edition-grain sC1-sC4, CFG2). Semantics -- a code is never a module series or a frozen letter, DD is refused, producer-side rows are samples, a real row's area_product_id resolves in the graph -- live in drydocs_core/edition_registry.py and tests/unit/test_edition_registry.py.

updated.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

code.description: the id segment; unique, never a module code, never a frozen letter, never DD

area_product_id.description: the :AreaProduct key (K5 sB) the edition is cut at

minted_by.description: the BASE that declared it (sB2: a base mints, an instance requests)

registered_at.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

legacy_band.description: the numeric band this edition's ids used before it had a code; history only

sample.description: true on a synthetic row; the producer's file carries samples only
